name: Tsurugi Koutarou
source:
A second-year student at Narahama High School.

With folded sleeves, spiked hair, and a really vulgar demeanor, he's the kind of hoodlum you wouldn't wanna get close to.

Behind his back, everyone whispers he isn't worthy of being a resident here in the Clearworld.

Though his past has left him seeming like a jagged edge, his outstanding reflexes have made him a scholarship student in the world of athletics, not to mention his decent grades, constant attendance, and shockingly serious attitude.
